correctness.rationale: Exact stationarity representation: A~Exp(r), X_i=sqrt(2DA)Z_i, yielding rho=(c+(1-pi/4)m^2)/(v+(1-pi/4)m^2). Gaussian min/max order-statistic integrals derive rho2=-1/3, rho3<0, rho4>0. With b_N=Phi^-1(1-1/N), joint opposite normalized maxima converge to independent Gumbels and explicit uniform fourth-moment tail bounds justify covariance convergence: v_N b_N^2->pi^2/6, c_N b_N^2->0, m_N/b_N->1, b_N^2~2 log N, implying the sharp pi^2/[6(4-pi)] coefficient. The standalone 28-assertion checker corroborates finite algebra and moments, not the infinite-N limit. Signed extremes and all normalization conditions stated.

value.rationale: Right and left occupied fronts are physically interpretable spatial-extreme observables in a correlated resetting gas. A population-controlled reversal between the first three and fourth particles demonstrates how the shared reset age overcomes within-sample extreme anticorrelation; the precise log-squared synchronization deficit quantifies how slowly both fronts lock. These statements are distinct from known single-extreme distributions or adjacent-gap correlations and may guide extreme-front dependence estimation; they do not assert a new stationary joint distribution or an unmotivated parameter slice.
